Apple's new smart home hub, commonly referred to as the "HomePad," is reportedly set to launch on October 13. The latest leaks have revealed the possible body colors it may come in.

The colors for the HomePad may include Silver, Space Gray, Starlight, and Rose Pink

Last night, leaker pdfu posted multiple images appearing to show the HomePad setup process. This isn't pdfu's first leak — they previously revealed several new features of the iPhone Duo, many of which are likely to extend to the HomePad as well.

In a subsequent post, pdfu indicated that the HomePad may come in four body colors:

  • Silver
  • Space Gray
  • Starlight
  • Rose Pink

As shown in the images below, the HomePad's setup process appears to preset different preview images based on the model color being used.

According to earlier reports, the HomePad will offer watchOS-like customizable watch faces for users to configure.

The images found by pdfu showcase Apple's "Photo Face" feature on the new smart home hub, and also reveal the square-shaped body design it will adopt.

What do you think of the HomePad color options reported this time? Feel free to leave a comment and share your thoughts.
